card.name: Digits inside dotted numbers
card.fires_on: A digit in the middle or end of a dotted number, such as an IP address or a section reference like 14.1 or 1194.2. It tends to be a second digit after a first digit.

modes.label: IP address digits
modes.description: A digit inside a dotted IP address.

modes.label: Section number digits
modes.description: The last digit of a numbered section or table reference, such as Clinical Studies (14.x).
modes.example: [see Clinical Studies (14.2<<0>>) ] . For use of KEYTR

card.plain: It fires on a digit within a number made of parts joined by dots, like an IP address or a section number.
